title: Open Effect Catalog: one entry
description: One effect or application, stored as effects/<id>.yaml. The field names follow the TRIZ Effects Database by TRIZ Consulting Group so that a release stays drop-in compatible with its effects.json. Cross-references (cells, uses, authors) are checked by tools/build.py, not by this schema.

id.description: Stable identifier, identical to the file name. Never changes once published.

kind.description: effect = a physical, chemical, biological or geometric phenomenon; application = a technical use that combines effects.

home.description: The function cell (action|object) in which the entry was first found. A note on origin only.

functions.description: Every function cell (action|object) the entry can fulfil. Ids come from vocabulary/vocabulary.yaml.

parameters.description: Parameter cells (operation|parameter): the second, independent view on the same entry.

uses.description: For applications: ids of the effects this application relies on.

domain.description: Scientific field. Empty strings are allowed (applications usually have none).

maturity.description: Effects: lehrbuch | nische | verbreitet. Applications (S-curve): kindheit | wachstum | reife | niedergang. Empty = not assessed.

sources.description: Where the facts can be looked up (URL or literature reference). Sources are for looking up, never for copying wording.

authors.description: People who wrote the entry. Empty only for a machine draft (every text kind: maschinell, with model). Kept as data; downstream attribution happens centrally via NOTICE.md.

review.description: Human review. Only entries with status geprueft go into a release. A reviewer has checked the facts against the sources, that the wording is not copied, and the cells.

by.description: Who reviewed the entry (people, or the publishing organisation for imported collections).

origin.description: Key of the upstream collection this entry was taken over from (see dataset.yaml -> origins). Omit for entries written for this project.

text.description: Texts per language (ISO 639-1 code). At least one language.

kind.description: original = written in this language; geprueft = translation read by a person; maschinell = machine translation nobody has read yet.

model.description: AI model that produced a translation, if any.

updated.description: Date of the last change to this language version (YYYY-MM-DD).
